hooks.text: The Sun is the most perfect sphere in nature.
Is anything in the cosmos a perfect sphere?
Violent solar storms cannot distort the Sun's shape.

title: The Sun is the most perfect sphere in nature
description: NASA satellite measurements revealed that the Sun holds a virtually unyielding round shape despite violent solar magnetic cycles. From core fusion to the outer heliosphere, its disk remains locked.

beats.text: The Sun is the most perfect sphere in nature.
beats.visual: Sun full disk in high resolution observed by Solar Dynamics Observatory, 2012

beats.text: Even violent eleven-year magnetic storms cannot bulge its disk.
beats.visual: Sunspot groups and magnetic plasma loops on the solar surface observed by SDO, 2012
queries: Solar magnetic field lines coronal loops SDO

beats.text: NASA's Solar Dynamics Observatory measured this roundness from space.
beats.visual: Artist illustration of NASA's Solar Dynamics Observatory spacecraft in Earth orbit, 2010

beats.text: Deep inside, fusion converts hydrogen into helium.
beats.visual: Cross-section diagram illustrating nuclear fusion processes inside the Sun's core, 2020
queries: Proton proton chain nuclear fusion diagram

beats.text: The proton-proton chain generates ninety-nine percent of that power.
beats.visual: Scientific diagram of the proton-proton chain nuclear fusion reaction cycle, 2020
queries: Proton proton chain nuclear fusion diagram

beats.text: The CNO cycle adds around one percent more.
beats.visual: Liquid scintillator vessel inside the Borexino solar neutrino detector, 2020
queries: Borexino detector inner sphere Gran Sasso

beats.text: This energy drives a magnetized solar wind.
beats.visual: Illustration of magnetized solar wind plasma streaming outward from the Sun, 2015

beats.text: That wind inflates a giant shield called the heliosphere.
beats.visual: Diagram showing the heliosphere shielding the solar system from cosmic rays, 2013

beats.text: Voyager 1 crossed it into interstellar space.
beats.visual: Artist concept of Voyager 1 crossing into interstellar space past the heliosphere, 2012

beats.text: Yet across all scales, the Sun remains a perfect sphere.
beats.visual: High resolution full disk SDO photograph showing the perfectly round solar edge, 2012
